cards.ex: Sending a probe to that distant nebula is a shot in the dark, but the potential rewards are huge.
cards.exUz: Uzoq tumanlikka zond yuborish - bu taxminiy urinish, ammo potentsial mukofotlar juda katta.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday aniq ma'lumotga ega bo'lmasdan qilingan taxmin yoki urinish.

cards.ex: The initial Mars rover design failed, so it's back to the drawing board for the engineers.
cards.exUz: Mars roverining dastlabki dizayni muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, shuning uchun muhandislar uchun qayta boshlash kerak.
cards.term: go back to the drawing board
cards.uzDef: Reja yoki g'oya ishlamasa, uni qayta ko'rib chiqish va yangidan boshlash.

cards.ex: Exploring those impact craters on the far side of the moon is really off the beaten track.
cards.exUz: Oyning uzoq tomonidagi zarba kraterlarini o'rganish haqiqatan ham chekka hudud.
cards.uzDef: Odatda borilmaydigan, ko'pchilikka noma'lum joy yoki usul.

cards.ex: The discovery of potential biosignatures on Venus will fuel the debate about life beyond Earth.
cards.exUz: Venerada potentsial biobelgilarni topish Yer tashqarisidagi hayot haqidagi bahsni qizdiradi.
cards.uzDef: Bahs-munozaralarni kuchaytirish, yangi dalillar yoki fikrlar bilan ta'minlash.

cards.ex: The original Star Trek series was truly ahead of its time in its vision of space travel.
cards.exUz: Star Trek seriali kosmik sayohat haqidagi tasavvurida haqiqatan ham zamondan ilg'or edi.
cards.uzDef: O'z davriga nisbatan ancha ilg'or, yangi va innovatsion.

cards.ex: With new private space companies, commercial lunar missions are on the horizon.
cards.exUz: Yangi xususiy kosmik kompaniyalar bilan tijorat oy missiyalari ufqda.
cards.uzDef: Yaqin kelajakda sodir bo'lishi kutilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: Developing fusion power would be a quantum leap for space propulsion technology.
cards.exUz: Termoyadroviy quvvatni rivojlantirish kosmik harakatlanish texnologiyasi uchun keskin sakrash bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va muhim o'zgarish yoki taraqqiyot.

cards.ex: Asteroid mining represents a new frontier in resource extraction.
cards.exUz: Asteroid qazib olish resurslarni qazib olishda yangi chegarani anglatadi.
cards.uzDef: O'rganilmagan yoki rivojlanmagan soha.

cards.ex: Building a Dyson sphere around the sun is still pie in the sky, but it's fascinating to think about.
cards.exUz: Quyosh atrofida Dyson sferasini qurish hali amalga oshmas orzu, lekin bu haqda o'ylash qiziqarli.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshishi dargumon bo'lgan orzu yoki reja.

cards.ex: SpaceX really took off as a company when they started landing rockets.
cards.exUz: SpaceX raketalarni qo'ndirishni boshlaganida, kompaniya sifatida haqiqatan ham muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanish yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: If we don't address space debris, we're on a collision course with disaster.
cards.exUz: Agar biz kosmik chiqindilarni hal qilmasak, biz falokat bilan to'qnashuv yo'lida bo'lamiz.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilik yoki muammoga olib keladigan yo'nalishda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Scientists are constantly pushing the boundaries of our understanding of the universe.
cards.exUz: Olimlar doimo koinot haqidagi tushunchamiz chegaralarini kengaytirishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud chegaralardan o'tib, yangi narsalarni kashf qilish yoki erishish.

cards.ex: From the first humans to venture out of Africa, exploration is in our blood.
cards.exUz: Afrikadan tashqariga chiqqan birinchi odamlardan boshlab, tadqiqot bizning qonimizda bor.
cards.uzDef: Odam tabiatan yangi narsalarni o'rganishga intiladi.

cards.ex: Building a permanent base on the Moon is a giant undertaking, requiring international cooperation.
cards.exUz: Oyda doimiy baza qurish - bu katta ish, xalqaro hamkorlikni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Katta miqyosdagi, murakkab va ko'p harakat talab qiladigan ish.

cards.ex: The details of the new lunar rover are still being kept under wraps.
cards.exUz: Yangi Oy roverining tafsilotlari hali ham sir saqlanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Maxfiy saqlanmoqda, omma oldida oshkor qilinmagan.

cards.ex: We can't lose sight of the importance of international collaboration in space exploration.
cards.exUz: Kosmik tadqiqotlarda xalqaro hamkorlikning ahamiyatini unutib qo'ymasligimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muhim narsani unutib qo'ymoq yoki e'tibordan chetda qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: Investing in fusion research for space travel requires a leap of faith in future technology.
cards.exUz: Kosmik sayohat uchun termoyadroviy tadqiqotlarga sarmoya kiritish kelajak texnologiyasiga ishonch qadamini talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Dalillarsiz yoki ishonchsiz bo'lsada, biror narsaga ishonib qadam tashlash.

cards.ex: Finding definitive proof of life on Mars is a long shot, but worth pursuing.
cards.exUz: Marsda hayotning aniq dalillarini topish - bu amalga oshishi qiyin, ammo izlashga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish ehtimoli kam bo'lgan urinish.

cards.ex: To solve the problem of interstellar travel, we need to think outside the box.
cards.exUz: Yulduzlararo sayohat muammosini hal qilish uchun biz standartdan tashqari fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va ijodiy yechimlarni topish uchun odatiy fikrlashdan tashqari o'ylash.

cards.ex: Space exploration requires cutting-edge technology in propulsion, robotics, and life support.
cards.exUz: Kosmik tadqiqot harakatlanish, robototexnika va hayotni ta'minlash sohalarida eng zamonaviy texnologiyani talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Eng so'nggi, eng ilg'or va innovatsion texnologiya.

cards.ex: International cooperation in space exploration is a win-win situation for all participating countries.
cards.exUz: Kosmik tadqiqotlarda xalqaro hamkorlik - bu barcha ishtirok etuvchi davlatlar uchun yutuqli vaziyat.
cards.uzDef: Barcha tomonlar uchun foydali bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: It takes years for astronauts to learn the ropes of space travel and mission operations.
cards.exUz: Kosmonavtlarga kosmik sayohat va missiya operatsiyalari asoslarini o'rganish uchun yillar kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi faoliyat yoki ishning asoslarini o'rganish.

cards.ex: An internship at NASA is a great way to get a foot in the door in the space industry.
cards.exUz: NASAda stajirovka kosmik sanoatda imkoniyatga ega bo'lishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.term: get a foot in the door
cards.uzDef: Ishga kirish yoki biror sohaga kirish uchun birinchi imkoniyatni qo'lga kiritish.

cards.ex: What would you take with you if you were going to Mars?
cards.exUz: Agar Marsga ketayotgan bo'lsangiz, o'zingiz bilan nima olib ketgan bo'lardingiz?
cards.uzDef: Biror joyga, masalan, kosmosga nimadir olib ketmoq.

cards.ex: We need to iron out the kinks in the new spacesuit design before it's safe for use.
cards.exUz: Foydalanish xavfsiz bo'lishidan oldin, yangi kosmik kostyum dizaynidagi kamchiliklarni bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni hal qilish va yaxshilash orqali biror narsani mukammallashtirish.

cards.ex: There are several new space telescopes in the pipeline, promising exciting discoveries.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta yangi kosmik teleskoplar rejalashtirilgan, ular hayajonli kashfiyotlarni va'da qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda rivojlanayotgan yoki rejalashtirilgan, yaqin kelajakda amalga oshirilishi kutilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: With private companies entering the space industry, the sky's the limit for innovation.
cards.exUz: Kosmik sanoatga xususiy kompaniyalar kirishi bilan, innovatsiyalar uchun chegara yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Erişilebilecek hech qanday chegara yo'q, imkoniyatlar cheksiz.

cards.ex: The first successful landing on Mars was a watershed moment in space exploration.
cards.exUz: Marsga birinchi muvaffaqiyatli qo'nish kosmik tadqiqotlarda burilish nuqtasi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim o'zgarishlarga olib keladigan muhim voqea.

cards.ex: For now, interstellar travel remains beyond our grasp due to technological limitations.
cards.exUz: Hozircha, yulduzlararo sayohat texnologik cheklovlar tufayli bizning imkoniyatimizdan tashqari qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Erişib bo'lmaydigan, tushunish qiyin.

cards.ex: In the grand scheme, understanding the universe is a fundamental human endeavor.
cards.exUz: Umumiy reja bo'yicha, koinotni tushunish - bu insonning asosiy harakati.
cards.uzDef: Kattaroq, muhimroq kontekstda.
